name: kettlebell one arm thruster
description: A kettlebell squat-to-press combo done with one arm that works the legs, shoulders and core in one flow.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your torso upright and elbow close to your body.
Stand up powerfully through your heels.
Press the kettlebell overhead as you rise, finishing with a straight arm.
Lower it back to the rack and go into the next squat.
